metadata.author: Endurance
metadata.disclaimer: This plan is educational and general. It is not medical advice or a substitute for a qualified coach or clinician. Stop and seek professional guidance for pain, illness, dizziness, chest symptoms, or unusual fatigue.

name: 36‑Week First Full‑Distance

phases.name: Foundation
phases.objective: Establish routine, swim technique, and easy aerobic volume.

phases.name: Base 1
phases.objective: Grow aerobic endurance across all three disciplines.

phases.name: Base 2
phases.objective: Extend long sessions; introduce steady tempo.

phases.name: Build 1
phases.objective: Add threshold work and progressive weekend bricks.

phases.name: Race‑specific build
phases.objective: Race‑pace practice on tired legs; open‑water skills.

phases.name: Peak
phases.objective: Highest specific volume and a final big simulation.

phases.name: Taper
phases.objective: Cut volume, keep some intensity, arrive fresh.
